title: Inventory and Glasshouse
author: R. M. Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Zhou, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
